app.title: Show HN: Reladraw – A diagram language where you decide where to place things
app.author: jpwalsh234
app.description: A diagram language and editor that lets users explicitly place elements, providing fine‑grained layout control.
proposed_tests: Install via npm and run the development server.
Create a simple diagram and verify it renders correctly.
Export the diagram to SVG and check for expected node positions.
Run the CLI renderer on a sample file and compare output size.
Measure bundle size and load time on a standard browser.
